details: overall_score must equal the mean of four rubric scores
current_stage must be a documented stage
Known anomalies are stored separately from operational input tables
Technical-stage applications without a completed prior review need investigation; simplified prototype gate check
Same interviewer/date/start slot used by multiple active interviews
Withdrawn applications should not have scheduled or rescheduled interviews
Out-of-band offers must be rejected or escalated
Only documented job-related rubric criteria should be used
